title: Forecasting and Analyzing Cash Flow
overview: Cash flow is the lifeline of any successful and sustainable business. This course provides participants with the knowledge and tools to master cash flow and working capital management, ensuring the effective utilization of cash resources. Participants will gain hands-on expertise in preparing cash flow statements using both direct and indirect methods, along with techniques for accurate cash flow forecasting and analysis.
audience: This course is designed for financial controllers, working capital managers, financial analysts, business development managers, financial managers, management accountants, business analysts, and treasury professionals.
methodology: The course combines practical, Excel-based applications of cash flow analysis with in-depth discussions of theoretical concepts. Participants will engage in real-life case studies, interactive exercises, and peer presentations to enhance learning and application.
competencies: Constructing and analyzing cash flow statements
Performing and interpreting cash flow ratios
Identifying and resolving cash flow issues
Assessing the impact of working capital on cash flow
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the relationships between cash flow statements, income statements, and balance sheets.
Identify the critical elements and significance of organizational cash flow.
Prepare cash flow statements using both direct and indirect methods.
Assess the impact of working capital management on cash flow.
Analyze organizational liquidity and cash flow positions, including free cash flow.
Review best practices for presenting cash flow data.
Apply effective cash flow forecasting techniques.
Perform cash flow ratio analysis to gain deeper insights.
